source_notes: The official page still reports 24 member boards, 38 specialty areas, and 89 subspecialty areas on 2026-07-27.
Medical Physics is displayed as one grouped label on the source page; Diagnostic, Nuclear, and Therapeutic tracks remain separate canonical specialty nodes so the official count remains 38.

Board-specific display labels for Anesthesiology Critical Care Medicine, Internal Medicine-Critical Care Medicine, and Pathology – Molecular Genetic are preserved on offering edges while resolving to the canonical Critical Care Medicine and Molecular Genetic Pathology subspecialty areas.
Asterisk-marked offerings retain approved_not_yet_issued metadata on their board-to-certificate edges.
